name: Suzu○ Haruhi no Gekisatsu
source:
"Kyon! We're making an adult video!" 
Her voice called excitedly from the Lit Club room. 
Mikuru shuddered, Yuki was silent, Itsuki grinned wryly, and Kyon shouted. 

Sexplosive crazy ideal from the SOS Brigade leader! 
The characters are pulled into a variety of ecchi movie scenes. 

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE093587.html]DLsite English[/url]]
